caseNameFull: Pelley v. Colpoys, U. S. Marshal
attorneys: Mr. T. Edward O’Connell for petitioner. Assistant Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Berge, and Messrs. Oscar A. Provost and Edward M. Curran for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia denied.

Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
